heading.title: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India

article.title: Power to designate financial sector regulator.
article.content: Until the Board is established, the Central Government may by notification, designate any financial sector regulator to exercise the powers and functions of the Board under this Code.
article.html:
195Power to designate financial sector regulator.

Section 195 · Part IV · Chapter I · page 129 of the Act

Until the Board is established, the Central Government may by notification, designate any financial sector regulator to exercise the powers and functions of the Board under this Code.
